name: cloudflare-diagram
title: CloudflareDiagram
description: Cloudflare's services on a Diagram: each a node with what it can call and receive as ports, from a catalog generated from Cloudflare's docs, Wrangler's schema and the Workers types. A connection can only be one the catalog says there is, and it offers the real methods. No Cloudflare artwork. ELK is an optional peer.
